tonight.headline: Daniels is cleared — but Los Cachanillas fixed their lineup and the game is tighter
body: Bad news first: Rashee Rice is out (hamstring, knee — Chiefs.com) and Josh Jacobs cannot play until Week 7. And Los Cachanillas did what this morning's brief said they had not: they dropped Jalen Hurts for Dameon Pierce and swapped the Vikings' defence (bye) for the Ravens. Their projection went from 85.9 to 110.4, and ESPN's odds for you from 72% to 59%.

Your side is unchanged and correct: 127.7 projected, the projection lineup. Washington's Saturday report gives Jayden Daniels no designation after three full practices (Commanders.com 17 Oct), so the Stroud fallback is retired. Nothing to do.

case.label: Why nothing
case.body: Every starter is cleared on the final reports (NFL.com Week 6). The margin is projection, not news, and there is no unpriced item on your roster to act on.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A surprise inactive: Tuten at 06:00 Sunday (London); Taylor, Wilson or Likely at 09:30; Golden or Pickens at 16:50; Daniels Monday 16:45 — by then Stroud is locked, so a Monday scratch cannot be covered.

waiverAnalysis.summary: The tool flags eight risers because its weakest movable back is Josh Jacobs — exempt-list zeros, not a role — and its weakest receiver is Rice, ruled out. None is a move: Jacobs is eligible in Week 7, Worthy already covers Rice, and priority never resets. Five weeks of data — still thin.
